title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Blueberry Pomegranate Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blueberry Pomegranate combines sweet, juicy Blueberry with the rich, slightly tart depth of Pomegranate for a balanced, layered fruit flavour. The mix delivers a smooth, satisfying vape with a clean, cool edge on the exhale. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod includes a prefilled 2ml pod and integrated 10ml refill reservoir, totalling 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No refilling, no separate coils. Simply attach to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. The dual mesh coil ensures consistent vapour and clarity of flavour for up to 6000 puffs (approx.), after which the pod can be replaced easily. Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
